comments.text:
About 1,400 people share every square mile of Rwanda's hills, and once a month, a whole Saturday morning is shared too. 🌄
If you lived here for a month, which would you sign up for first: the Saturday umuganda on your street, a tea harvest in Nyungwe, or one hour with the gorillas?

comments.text: The $1,500 gorilla permit stopped me in my tracks - one hour with the gorillas costing more than many families there earn in months says so much about Rwanda. I loved how the film still gave most of its time to ordinary daily life, the markets, the hills and people just getting on with their day.
